title: how-to-assign-licenses.html
content: Click the Gear icon in the upper right-hand corner. Click Setup . Type “Installed Packages” in the Quick Find box.  Click Installed Packages . Click Manage Licenses next to the package you need to assign. ( and licenses are separate.) Click Add Users . Check the box next to the Available Users that you need to assign licenses to. Click Add . Repeat Steps 5-8 for any additional package licenses you need to assign.
